name: crease-clash
description: Crease Clash - an original 3D cricket game built around 2v2 multiplayer

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @crease/client && npm run build -w @crease/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sim && tsc -p packages/net && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client --noEmit
